steps.title: Crundi's own inbox
steps.body: Everything meant for you now lands in Crundi's inbox first: what Claude sends you, alerts, questions and permission requests, Cru's reports and Crundi's own notices. It is in threads, one per chat, per project, Cru and Crundi. Telegram and the other channels only send copies, and Crundi works fully without Telegram.

keys.text: on the PC and the web

steps.title: Sign in with Google or GitHub
steps.body: Sign in with your own Google or GitHub account, through an OAuth app you create. Only the account you set is let in, and a method switches on only after its test passes. In the PC app, sign-in opens in your browser and you confirm a short code.
